title: BINI Nominated for SEC Awards 2026
message: Please vote for BINI's nomination for 2 categories at the SEC Awards 2026: 'INTERNATIONAL GROUP/DOUBLE OF THE YEAR' - (https://seriesemcena.com.br/sec-awards-2026/grupo-dupla-internacional-do-ano/) and 'INTERNATIONAL ALBUM/EP OF THE YEAR' - (https://seriesemcena.com.br/sec-awards-2026/album-ep-internacional-do-ano/) for 'Flames'.
